title: Buffalo with Theodore Carpenter and Jimmy Harrison's band
summary: Trumpeter Theodore Carpenter sends for him to Buffalo, where he plays with pianist Jimmy Harrison; dates are sorted out.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: No, no. I went from Cincinnati ... up here. Wingy (2) Carpenter, I don't know if you know him, trumpet player. The name is Theodore Carpenter.

Right. I met him in Cincinnati and he was playing on the band there so he came to Buffalo and he sent for me to come to Buffalo, New York so I played there for about a little over a year. I played with Jim Harrison's band there, a piano player and Eugene Promise MN.
Yeah. No, not the trombone player. No, lots of people get it mixed up. No, he played piano. But there was,
Was there a Jimmy Harrison trombone player?
Oh, yes and how ... listened to him all the time ...
Now when did you go to Cincinnati?
I went to Cincinnati twice. The last time I went there I think it was in 1924.
Now did you leave specifically to join a band or something like that?
Yes, I did. In 1924 I went to Buffalo, New York.
A guy sent for me, this trumpet player ... used to play in church. Theodore Carpenter (both talking)
Yeah, I read that in one of the history books. He worked in Buffalo up there.
This was in 1928, September 8, 1928. You weren't even born.
